name: io.github.up2itnow0822/agentpay
description: Non-custodial x402 payment MCP server for AI agents. Wallets and payments on 17 chains.

environmentVariables.description: Private key for the agent wallet's local signer (hex string)
environmentVariables.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Address of the deployed AgentAccountV2 wallet the signer operates
environmentVariables.name: AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS

environmentVariables.description: RPC endpoint for on-chain operations; defaults to the chain's public RPC
environmentVariables.name: RPC_URL

environmentVariables.description: Operator spend policy: rolling 24h limit (ETH-equivalent decimal). Immutable from MCP. Value-moving tools refuse to run until an operator policy (AGENTPAY_POLICY_*) is set or AGENTPAY_ALLOW_UNPOLICED_SPEND=1 is chosen explicitly.
environmentVariables.name: AGENTPAY_POLICY_DAILY_LIMIT_ETH

environmentVariables.description: Operator spend policy: per-transaction cap (ETH-equivalent decimal). Immutable from MCP. Value-moving tools refuse to run until an operator policy (AGENTPAY_POLICY_*) is set or AGENTPAY_ALLOW_UNPOLICED_SPEND=1 is chosen explicitly.
environmentVariables.name: AGENTPAY_POLICY_PER_TX_CAP_ETH

environmentVariables.description: Operator spend policy: comma-separated recipient allowlist (EVM addresses). Immutable from MCP. Value-moving tools refuse to run until an operator policy (AGENTPAY_POLICY_*) is set or AGENTPAY_ALLOW_UNPOLICED_SPEND=1 is chosen explicitly.
environmentVariables.name: AGENTPAY_POLICY_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to run WITHOUT an operator policy, relying only on on-chain AgentAccountV2 limits. Off by default. Value-moving tools refuse to run until an operator policy (AGENTPAY_POLICY_*) is set or AGENTPAY_ALLOW_UNPOLICED_SPEND=1 is chosen explicitly.
environmentVariables.name: AGENTPAY_ALLOW_UNPOLICED_SPEND

environmentVariables.description: Operator ceiling, in USDC, on every x402 payment (principal plus protocol fee). While set, x402 payments in other assets are refused.
environmentVariables.name: AGENTPAY_X402_MAX_PAYMENT

environmentVariables.description: Directory for the fsync'd spend-intent journal, so ambiguous-payment locks survive restarts. Recommended for long-lived servers.
environmentVariables.name: AGENTPAY_STATE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated hosts whose private network address is intentionally allowed for outbound requests.
environmentVariables.name: AGENTPAY_ALLOWED_PRIVATE_HOSTS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated hosts allowed as OTel kill-callback targets over plain http (e.g. in-VPC services).
environmentVariables.name: AGENTPAY_KILL_CALLBACK_ALLOWED_HOSTS

environmentVariables.description: Development only: set to 1 to permit private destinations and plain http.
environmentVariables.name: AGENTPAY_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK

environmentVariables.description: Default x402 session lifetime in seconds; defaults to 3600
environmentVariables.name: SESSION_TTL_SECONDS

environmentVariables.description: Default AgentAccountV2 factory address for deploy_wallet (can also be passed per call)
environmentVariables.name: FACTORY_ADDRESS

environmentVariables.description: Default NFT contract address for deploy_wallet (can also be passed per call)
environmentVariables.name: NFT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS
